description.value:
You summon the Shinigami (Death) and offer your own soul in exchange for tearing the soul of another being from its body. The Yondaime used this to seal the Kyuubi.

Choose a creature within 60 feet (you may target a soul still attached to a recently-deceased body within 1 minute of death). The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The Shinigami is angered and your own soul is consumed instantly: you die, and there is no body to resurrect.

Success The Shinigami extracts a small piece of the target's soul: the target loses 1 spell slot of its highest rank for 1 month (or until dispelled at counteract rank 9+).

Failure The Shinigami extracts the target's full soul: the target is reduced to 0 HP and dies. The soul is sealed inside the Shinigami's stomach, accessible only to the wielder of certain forbidden countertechniques.

Regardless of result, you die immediately after the jutsu resolves. Your soul is consumed by the Shinigami; you cannot be raised by normal resurrection means.

system.requirements: you accept that casting this jutsu kills you
